mapper.sql: id, code, name, category, targetcode, sender, starttime, state, flowgraph, endtime, remark

where.if: code in (select distinct workflow from page.flowhistory where dealuser=#{q.dealUser}) and sender!=#{q.dealUser}

mapper.select: SELECT a.workflow,a.flowgraph,a.flownode,a.starttime,a.remark, c.name as nodename,c.operator,c.rolelist,c.userlist, b.code,b.name,b.category,b.targetcode,b.sender, b.starttime as begintime,b.state FROM page.flowcurrent a,page.workflow b,page.flowNode c where a.workflow=b.code and a.flowgraph=c.flowgraph and a.flownode=c.code and ((c.rolelist like concat ('%',#{q.roleCode},'%') and c.operator='R') or ( c.userList like concat ('%',#{q.dealUser},'%') and c.operator='U')) ORDER BY a.starttime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM page.flowcurrent a,page.workflow b,page.flowNode c where a.workflow=b.code and a.flowgraph=c.flowgraph and a.flownode=c.code and ((c.rolelist like concat ('%',#{q.roleCode},'%') and c.operator='R') or ( c.userList like concat ('%',#{q.dealUser},'%') and c.operator='U'))
